description: Scoring live traffic after release: code-based checks on every response, judges on a sample, scores written onto traces.
Running a candidate on copies of real requests and scoring its outputs without showing them to users.
Signals from behavior (regenerate, heavy edits, copy, escalation, abandonment), more plentiful and often more honest than ratings.
Change under a shipped feature: inputs, the provider's model, prompts and configuration, knowledge, or the definition of correct.
Traces selected because something looked wrong (negative feedback, low score, guardrail hit). Rich in failures, biased for rates.
The list of sampled traces waiting for human review, sized to reviewer capacity and governed by labeling guidelines.
Production failures become reviewed golden cases and judge calibration data, so evals keep matching real traffic.
